scope: Create a reviewable normal-merge integration of exact canonical main into the exact ECO source head, prove the synthetic post-merge topology removes aggregate PC0 RED without runtime tree changes, open a draft PR targeting ECO, and stop before merge.
required_outputs: Pre-merge RED and synthetic post-merge NON_RED reports
stop_conditions: origin/main moves from 5ba1dcb7 or ECO target moves from 75c7794e at any point through draft PR, review or human merge
Merge conflict or non-control tree delta appears
Synthetic standard PC0 remains RED or directional PC0 becomes RED
Any runtime, passport, ecology or architecture edit is required
CONTROL_DOCS_ONLY_MERGE approval has not been granted
risk_reasons: Dependency integration changes ECO branch ancestry and PC0 critical-drift evaluation.
A false synthetic GREEN could incorrectly unblock H0.0.
The candidate has no runtime tree delta and changes no ownership, identity or foundation contract, so CRITICAL triggers are absent.

design_brief.problem_statement: Main generation 66 and the ECO passport now mirror P1B state, but ECO still has merge-base 790fd79f and therefore correctly reports RED critical dependency drift on the registry.
design_brief.current_behavior: Live pre-merge PC0 is RED for ECO even though the registry content was copied into ECO, because copying content does not integrate the canonical commits or move the merge-base.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A normal two-parent merge of exact main 5ba1dcb7 into a durable control head descended from exact ECO 75c7794e updates ancestry with no merge-induced tree delta. A synthetic ref at that merge must make aggregate PC0 NON_RED while directional findings remain YELLOW/non-critical.
alternatives_considered: Create a normal-merge draft PR into ECO
design_brief.selected_design: Use a new branch from the exact ECO head, add durable reviewed control records, pin the final pre-merge control head, create a non-fast-forward normal merge with that control head first and exact main second, validate synthetic remote topology in a clean clone, and open a draft PR targeting ECO.
design_brief.why_selected: Normal merge preserves recovery history, explicitly integrates canonical ancestry, avoids force-push, and lets the ECO owner review/merge a zero-runtime-delta candidate.
expected_risks: Source or main moves during any lifecycle phase
Merge parent invariant ignores durable planning commits
Verification uses live remote instead of synthetic exact ref
validation_plan: Fetch/prune and require exact main/ECO/passport identities before merge creation, synthetic PC0, evidence, exact review, draft PR and human merge.
Record live pre-merge PC0 RED as expected evidence, not failure of the candidate.
Pin the exact pre-merge control head and prove its first-parent ancestry contains exact ECO while source-to-control-head changes are allowed control records only.
Create a normal two-parent merge and assert first parent is the exact pre-merge control head, second parent is exact main, and merge-base(candidate, main) equals exact main.
Assert candidate tree equals the immediate first-parent tree; separately prove the source dry-merge tree equals the original ECO tree.
Assert ECO-source-to-candidate changes contain only this Work Order's control/evidence records and no runtime/passport/registry/architecture edits.
In a fresh URL clone, set a disposable synthetic ECO remote-tracking ref to the exact candidate while keeping origin/main exact, then run standard and directional PC0.
Require standard aggregate NON_RED and directional no RED critical hit.
Run independent exact-head Reviewer and Verifier, produce Evidence Map and draft PR targeting ECO.

notes: Epoch invalidated before merge creation: ECO target advanced from pinned 75c7794e to dc474554 immediately after dispatch. No merge candidate or runtime/content change was created. A replacement requires a new stable source pin and repeated pre-build review.
